entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me your order number?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. It's about the cycling shoes I bought.

Okay, I have your order pulled up. I see the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes, delivered 17 days ago. To make sure I understand, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I don't think they're broken, but they're just... they're not working for me. I've tried adjusting the cleats every which way, but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels. I can't even finish a short ride.
I understand, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Fit is incredibly important with performance gear like that.
It's just, I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I saved up for these. I really needed this money, and now I have shoes I can't even wear. I was hoping I could get a refund.
Let me just check the policy for you. One moment... Okay, I've confirmed it. Since you received the item 17 days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? So I can return them?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just pack the cycling shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive them, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Wow, that's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've really helped me out.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
